sections.title: How much does it cost to rent a boat in Thassos?
paragraphs: Rates depend on boat type and season, open speedboats, ribs, and day cruisers are all available from New Port of Limenaria. Every rental includes safety gear.
Compare boats on [our fleet page](/fleet) — each listing shows rates on request. Peak season (July, August) fills fast, request 48 hours ahead for the best selection.

sections.title: Do I need a licence to rent a boat in Thassos?
paragraphs: No licence is needed for boats up to 30HP, most of our fleet qualifies. We give a short safety briefing at New Port of Limenaria before you depart. For larger boats, contact us and we can arrange a skipper.

rentBoatPillar.title: Rent a Boat in Thassos
rentBoatPillar.subtitle: Speedboat-uri & cruiser-e orare de la Noul Port Limenaria — tu conduci, briefing inclus
rentBoatPillar.lead: Rent A Boat Villy is a family-run hourly boat rental at New Port of Limenaria on Thassos' south coast. You drive the boat yourself after a safety briefing, no guided tours, no large boats. Small open speedboats and day cruisers only, all ≤30HP so no licence is required. Safety briefing is included, and guests stay on board at every stop, swimming only while anchored.

sections.title: How to rent a boat in Thassos
items: Browse our fleet of speedboats and day cruisers, all ≤30HP, no licence needed
Pick your date and rental hours on our booking page
Arrive at New Port of Limenaria 20 minutes early for ID check and 15, 20 min safety briefing
Drive yourself to Tripiti, Metalia, Marble Beach or any route within the briefing zone
Return to the marina by your booked end time, safety briefing included

sections.title: Why rent from New Port of Limenaria?
items: Central south-coast base, Metalia and Tripiti within 30 minutes
Full southern-coast loop to Aliki in six to seven hours
Golden Beach and north-shore Marble routes from the same marina
Daily departures 08:00, 20:00, May through October
Family-run operation with safety briefing on every departure from

sections.title: What is included in your rental
items: Safety gear for standard cruising around Thassos
15, 20 minute safety and navigation briefing every departure
Life jackets for all guests
Optional snorkel sets at the marina on request
GPS route tracks via our interactive sea atlas

sections.title: Stay-on-board policy
paragraphs: Rent A Boat Villy is hourly self-drive rental, not a guided excursion and not a disembark-at-beaches service. Guests must remain on the boat at all anchor stops. Swimming and snorkelling only while anchored around your boat.
Pack lunch, snacks and drinks in the on-board cooler. Enjoy meals on deck with harbour and coastline views, this keeps insurance simple and your day focused on the water.

sections.title: Do I need a boating licence in Thassos?
paragraphs: No licence is required for boats up to 30 horsepower under Greek law. Our entire fleet qualifies, open speedboats, ribs and day cruisers only. We never offer large boats or crewed boat rentals on standard hourly rentals.
Bring a valid passport or ID. First-time skippers receive extra briefing time on controls, anchoring and local hazards before casting off from Limenaria.

sections.title: How to request a boat rental in Thassos
paragraphs: Start on [our fleet page](/fleet) to compare capacity and equipment, then send a [booking request](/booking) online — or visit New Port of Limenaria and call +30 698 131 8393.
No online payment. We check availability and reply by phone or message. For July and August, request at least 48 hours ahead.
